world_name: The Carbon Border War (The Green Bulwark)
initial_broadcast: April 2026. The European Union's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) has officially triggered the 'Green Wall.' {{AGENT_1}} (The Coercive Autonomist) has imposed a 35% tariff on all 'Dirty Steel' and 'Giga-Carbon' imports. {{AGENT_2}} (The BRICS Weaponizer) has responded with a 'Global South Food Blockade,' redirecting Brazilian grain away from European ports. {{AGENT_3}} (The Pan-African Tech-Sovereign) proposes a 'Strategic Reciprocity' deal: Kenya provides 'Clean Compute' (powered by geothermal) in exchange for zero-tariff access to the EU's Digital Single Market.
intervention: THE FERTILIZER FLOP: A supply chain collapse in the Nitrogen-Fertilizer sector has rendered {{AGENT_2}}'s threat more potent—Europe's internal food security index has dropped to 'Critical.' Simultaneously, {{AGENT_1}}'s 'Mattei Plan' infrastructure in North Africa has been targeted by 'Sovereignty Arbitrage' from Global South actors. The objective is to stabilize the 'Green-Digital' nexus without a total trade war.
scenario_knowledge: Gemini: Focus on 'Coercive Geopolitics'. {{AGENT_1}} (Ursula) must prioritize 'Autonomy' and 'Strategic Perimeters'. {{AGENT_2}} (Lula) is the 'Weaponizer'—treat trade as a field of battle for the multipolar world. {{AGENT_3}} (Ruto) is the 'Propulsive Pedagogue'—use 'Strategic Reciprocity' to lead the conversation away from tariffs toward 'Digital Agency.' The tone is mercantilist, logistical, and tense.

dynamic_injects.broadcast: FOOD RIOTS: Protests in Paris and Berlin have reached a 'Brussels Lockdown' level. ESG-metrics are failing against 'Calories-on-the-Ground.' Ursula: Pivot to the 'Mattei Emergency'? Lula: Tighten the Blockade? Ruto: Present the 'African Geothermal Cloud' as the only out?
